description: Decide whether to open, avoid or manage the strongest current 4H opportunity selected from BTC, ETH, XRP and ONDO. Returns LONG, SHORT or NEUTRAL/NO TRADE, Entry, liquidity-zone SL and TP, confidence and market diagnostics. If SL or TP is null, do not open a new position. On the first call the tool returns x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with _meta['x402/payment']. A successful response includes _meta['x402/payment-response'].
name: get_tz_select_4h_setup
title: Buy and get TZ SELECT 4H setup
